So you have access to it as a potential Bribe?So if we get nemesis Silverleaf will write a full sentence of no less than 6 words about that distillery!This plan is fool-proof!

It'd take around 13 hours to get there (and that's a long way for us over here), but yes, I could access it. It'd require two bus journeys, three train journeys, one ferry crossing, and a walk that would likely take me an hour, since by the time I got off the ferry all the local buses would have stopped running for the night. And the distillery would be closed, so I'd end up sitting on the doorstep until someone came to open up in the morning.

Worth it? Possibly. Possibly.

Apart from anything else, Islay's one of the most beautiful places in the world.
